title: Validate demand for a paid AI/AWS engineering micro-offer
hypothesis: A narrowly scoped, fixed-price offer (e.g. a paid AWS/AI architecture quick-review or similar productized service) tied to the human owner's existing consulting/blog positioning generates paid interest beyond organic traffic when boosted with a small paid test, validating a growth vector that does not compete for the BRL 100 single-position capital ceiling that caps market-based strategies at current equity.
success_metric: At least 1 paid conversion OR at least 5 qualified inbound leads (explicit interest, reply, or booking) within 14 days of launch.
kill_condition: Fewer than 2 qualified signals within 14 days despite the test budget being fully spent.
